items.Sentence: The limits for total coliform and fecal coliform shall apply prior to discharge of the effluent into the leachfield disposal system. Effluent (wastewater discharged from the Malibu Bay Club WWTP) shall not contain heavy metals, arsenic, or cyanide, or other pollutants designated Priority Pollutants ... Effluent shall not contain organic chemicals, in concentrations exceeding the limits contained in the current California Drinking Water Standards...
